post.text: A man who imitates the sounds he hears as close to the real thing as possible...and his friends' reactions. https://t.co/QZizUeu5Gj

description.description: A group of men are indoors, possibly in a dance studio. Two men are in the foreground, crouching. One man on the left is wearing a black hoodie and the other man on right is in a black t-shirt. The man on the right holds a basketball in his hands and makes it look like it popped or turned into a small white object, like a crumpled piece of paper or tissue, as he shows it to the camera. The man on the left and the group of men in the background react to this magic trick with surprise and excitement.
